sections.heading: What it is
sections.body: Eight weeks of daily practice built around three pillars: breath mechanics, ground-based movement, and the inner work that keeps a man steady under load.
points: Strength work that scales to any equipment

sections.heading: What changes
sections.body: Better sleep, a slower resting heart rate, and the ability to hold your centre in conversations and situations that used to spike you.

faq.q: Can I run it alongside Kettlebell Lifestyle?
faq.a: Yes. The breath and mobility work stack cleanly on top of your training days.
A single kettlebell and floor space is enough.
